items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Well, my idol on saxophone was the great guy that died with Duke. John Hopkins. That's the kind of style of sax I love.

ctx.x: Well, who did you like? Who did you listen to when you were coming out? Different issues.
Well, my idol on saxophone was the great guy that died with Duke. John Hopkins. That's the kind of style of sax I love.
Well, you know who his favorite was? Who? My favorite was Bechet. Oh, yeah, yeah. He loved Bechet. I don't see New Orleans.
